你的辣酱真好吃

lines.en: I’m afraid of the super moon
lines.zh: 我害怕超级月亮
根本没有神
: 然后——
转圈
扭动
跳舞
跳
: 然后，最后一步是——
把袜子穿回去
把灯关掉
剪九只羊的毛
喝一口

lines.en: : And I’m pretty sure that’s all you need to do.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，你要做的就是这些了。
: 我说对了吗？
: 你当然说对了。

lines.en: : You have proven your loyalty. And, in doing so, you have earned my special key.
lines.zh: : 你证明了你的忠诚。为此，你赢得了我的专属钥匙。
{i}你获得了一把“飞马座钥匙”！{/i}

lines.en: : This key will help you in the coming days, but please be sure to only use it if you are absolutely certain you {i}have{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 这把钥匙在今后的日子里会帮到你，但请务必只在{i}万不得已{/i}的时候使用它。

lines.en: : The world outside these walls is a terrifying-
lines.zh: : 这四壁之外的世界极其可怕——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I’ve heard it all before.
lines.zh: : 行行行。这些我都听过了。
: 可是——

lines.en: : Thanks for the key, Emissary of Pegasus. But I’ve got a whole bunch of crumpled up paper I have nothing to do with, so you’re going to have to deal with that for a little while.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的钥匙，飞马座使者。可我这儿还有一大堆皱巴巴的纸没处处理，所以你还得再陪我应付一阵子。
: 抱歉啊，老兄。
: 我觉得你——

lines.en: I fill the trash can back up and prepare myself for another garbage day.
lines.zh: 我把垃圾桶重新装满，为下一个垃圾日做准备。

lines.en: Now, time to figure out what to do with this key.
lines.zh: 现在，该琢磨拿这把钥匙做什么了。
: 不对。

lines.en: : I’m afraid this means you have {i}not{/i} proven your loyalty, and that you must retrace your steps if you are ever going to.
lines.zh: : 恐怕这意味着你{i}还{/i}没有证明你的忠诚，若想证明，你必须重走一遍流程。

lines.en: : But I’ve taken so many steps. Surely you don’t expect me to remember them all?
lines.zh: : 可我已经走了那么多步了。你总不至于指望我把每一步都记住吧？

lines.en: : And surely {i}you{/i} don’t expect me to assist in the efforts of someone who does not deserve my aid.
lines.zh: : 而{i}你{/i}总不至于指望我去帮助一个不配得到我帮助的人。
: 后会有期，Akira。
: 等等！飞马座使者！

lines.en: {i}You feel wave of exhaustion crash into your body. And, the next thing you know, you’re waking up all over again.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你感到一阵疲惫如潮水般撞进身体。回过神来时，你又一次醒来了。{/i}

lines.en: I gaze into the trashcan to find a bunch of crumpled up papers that I don’t remember putting there.
lines.zh: 我往垃圾桶里一看，里面是一堆我不记得自己扔过的皱纸团。

lines.en: I can’t remember the last time garbage was collected, but I sure hope it comes again soon so I can remember what the bottom of my trash can looks like.
lines.zh: 我不记得上次收垃圾是什么时候了，但我真心希望它快点再来，好让我回想起来垃圾桶底长什么样。

lines.en: Until then, I guess I’ll have to just store all of my surplus trash in the shower like I normally do.
lines.zh: 在那之前，我大概只能像往常一样，把多余的垃圾都堆在淋浴间里。

lines.en: Here’s to hoping it attracts more friends.
lines.zh: 但愿它能招来更多朋友。

lines.en: I approach a stuffed rabbit sitting on top of the refrigerator.
lines.zh: 我走向坐在冰箱顶上的那只毛绒兔子。

lines.en: : How can I be of service-pyon?
lines.zh: : 有什么可以为您效劳的，蹦？

lines.en: : It’s a rabbit noise-pyon. We say it so you know we are rabbits-pyon.
lines.zh: : 那是兔子的叫声，蹦。我们这么说，好让人知道我们是兔子，蹦。

lines.en: : Would the ears and bowtie and other rabbit-like features not be enough to do that?
lines.zh: : 那耳朵、领结和其他兔子般的特征，难道还不足以说明吗？

lines.en: : We don’t know-pyon. We never live long enough to find out-pyon.
lines.zh: : 我们不知道，蹦。我们从来活不到弄明白的那天，蹦。

lines.en: : Right...Well, can you pass me the EnviroKids Organic Gorilla Munch Cereal please?
lines.zh: : 好吧……那么，能把 EnviroKids 有机大猩猩麦片递给我吗？

lines.en: : No-pyon. You haven’t earned it yet-pyon.
lines.zh: : 不行，蹦。你还没挣到它呢，蹦。

lines.en: : Well, what can I do to earn it? I’m really hungry and wanted to spend the day eating EnviroKids Organic Gorilla Munch Cereal.
lines.zh: : 那我要怎么做才能挣到？我真的饿坏了，本来打算一整天就吃 EnviroKids 有机大猩猩麦片来着。

lines.en: : That’s a good question-pyon! Unfortunately, I don’t have the answer-pyon.
lines.zh: : 这是个好问题，蹦！可惜我没有答案，蹦。

lines.en: : Ughhhhh. You stuffed rabbits are always so confusing.
lines.zh: : 呃啊啊啊。你们这些毛绒兔子总是这么让人摸不着头脑。

lines.en: : Sorry-pyon! But maybe you can do something with this-pyon?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，蹦！不过也许你能拿这个做点什么，蹦？
{i}你获得了一个“怀旧性玩具”{/i}

lines.en: : What am I supposed to do with this?
lines.zh: : 这玩意儿我该拿来干嘛？

lines.en: : Don’t ask me-pyon! I’m just a rabbit-pyon!
lines.zh: : 别问我，蹦！我只是只兔子，蹦！

lines.en: : I’ll keep a close eye on what you’re doing though-pyon. Your cereal isn’t going anywhere-pyon!
lines.zh: : 不过我会盯着你做什么的，蹦。你的麦片跑不了，蹦！

lines.en: : Fine. Guess I’ll just have to deal with this stupid vibrating thing for now.
lines.zh: : 行吧。看来我暂时只能跟这个蠢兮兮的震动玩意儿耗着了。
: 就是这个劲头，蹦！
: 好极了。现在怎么办？
: 又见面了，蹦！

lines.en: : Hello, freezer rabbit. Have I earned the EnviroKids Organic Gorilla Munch Cereal yet?
lines.zh: : 你好，冷冻室兔子。我挣到 EnviroKids 有机大猩猩麦片了吗？

lines.en: : Not yet-pyon! But keep at it and I’m sure you will eventually-pyon!
lines.zh: : 还没有，蹦！不过继续加油，我相信你总有一天会挣到的，蹦！
: 呃啊啊啊啊。

lines.en: : Forget it. I’ll just do something else for now.
lines.zh: : 算了。我先干点别的吧。
: 又见面了，蹦！

lines.en: : Now, you listen here, freezer-rabbit. I’m tired of you holding the EnviroKids Organic Gorilla Munch Cereal hostage. And I’m not going to stand for it anymore.
lines.zh: : 你给我听好了，冷冻室兔子。我受够你把 EnviroKids 有机大猩猩麦片当人质了。我不会再忍了。
: 你听起来很生气，蹦！

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} angry-pyon. All I want is some cereal and you won’t give me any. This is child abuse.
lines.zh: : 我{i}就是{/i}生气，蹦。我只不过想要点麦片，你却不给我。这叫虐待儿童。

lines.en: : Sounds like you know a lot about child abuse-pyon!
lines.zh: : 听你这口气，对虐待儿童倒是挺懂的，蹦！

lines.en: : Just give me the cereal or I am going to throw you into the oven.
lines.zh: : 快把麦片给我，不然我就把你扔进烤箱。
: 嗯嗯嗯……蹦。

lines.en: : Well, you {i}have{/i} been pestering me rather frequently-pyon. And some extra leg room does sound nice-pyon.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你{i}确实{/i}缠我缠得挺勤的，蹦。而且多点活动空间听上去也不错，蹦。
: 那么……好吧，蹦！给你，蹦！

lines.en: {i}You have obtained “EnviroKids Organic Gorilla Munch Cereal”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你获得了“EnviroKids 有机大猩猩麦片”{/i}
: 现在满意了，蹦？

lines.en: : Very. Now, I just need to- wait a minute.
lines.zh: : 非常满意。现在我只需要——等一下。
: 怎么了吗，蹦？

lines.en: : I can hear something whirring inside of the box.
lines.zh: : 我听见盒子里有东西在嗡嗡转。

lines.en: : It’s probably a prize-pyon! Cereal always comes with a prize-pyon!
lines.zh: : 多半是奖品，蹦！麦片里一向有奖品，蹦！
: 我要把它拿出来吗？
: 拿出来，蹦！现在，蹦！

lines.en: I reach into the cereal box and-
lines.zh: 我把手伸进麦片盒，然后——
{i}你获得了一把“麦片钥匙”{/i}

lines.en: : Wow. I had no idea they were putting keys in cereal nowadays. Times have really changed.
lines.zh: : 哇。我都不知道现在麦片里还送钥匙。时代真是变了。

lines.en: : Did you read the fine print on the key-pyon?
lines.zh: : 你读钥匙上的小字了吗，蹦？
: 什么？

lines.en: : The fine print-pyon! The rules of the prize!
lines.zh: : 小字啊，蹦！奖品的使用规则！
: 呃。没有，等一下。

lines.en: I stare down at the key and read.
lines.zh: 我低头盯着那把钥匙读了起来。

lines.en: : Note...this key will self-destruct if you maintain possession of EnviroKids Organic Gorilla Munch Cereal.
lines.zh: : 注意……如果你继续持有 EnviroKids 有机大猩猩麦片，这把钥匙将自动销毁。

lines.en: : Uh-oh-pyon! Looks like you need to give the cereal back-pyon!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，蹦！看来你得把麦片还回来了，蹦！

lines.en: : Gosh darn it. This is the last time I ever buy an EnviroKids product.
lines.zh: : 该死。这是我最后一次买 EnviroKids 的东西了。

lines.en: : At least you got a key-pyon! May it help you in the coming days-pyon!
lines.zh: : 至少你得到了一把钥匙，蹦！愿它在今后的日子里帮到你，蹦！

lines.en: : Shut up, freezer rabbit. I’m never talking to you again.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，冷冻室兔子。我再也不跟你说话了。
: 再见，蹦！跟你玩得很开心，蹦！

lines.en: : Well...at least I have another key now.
lines.zh: : 好吧……至少我现在又有一把钥匙了。

lines.en: I make my way over to the freezer and notice there is something peculiar about it — namely the fact that I’m not supposed to store food inside.
lines.zh: 我走到冷冻室前，注意到它有点不对劲——具体来说，我本来不该把食物存在里面。

lines.en: Either way, I don’t have the time to worry about what I can and can’t make cold. I need to do something. And I need to do something right now.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我没时间去操心什么能冻、什么不能冻。我得做点什么。而且必须现在就做。
可我该做什么呢？
揍冷冻室一拳

lines.en: The freezer shakes, but not much else happens.
lines.zh: 冷冻室晃了晃，此外什么也没发生。
抚摸冷冻室

lines.en: I gently stroke the freezer, hoping it becomes aroused and opens itself up.
lines.zh: 我温柔地抚摸冷冻室，盼着它被撩起兴致，自己打开。
可惜什么也没发生。
插入蟑螂

lines.en: : I wonder if this will work?
lines.zh: : 不知道这招管不管用？

lines.en: Without knowing what else I’m supposed to do, I insert the roach I got from Molly into the freezer’s mouth...
lines.zh: 实在不知道还能怎么办，我把从 Molly 那儿得来的蟑螂插进了冷冻室的嘴里……
然后它突然开了！

lines.en: : Oh boy. I can’t wait to see what’s inside.
lines.zh: : 哦豁。我等不及想看看里面有什么了。

lines.en: : Hey, wait a minute. I thought I wasn’t supposed to store food in here?
lines.zh: : 嘿，等等。我不是不该把食物存在这里吗？

lines.en: A melon stares back at me and reminds me of better days...but I’m not supposed to touch it. Not even for sex.
lines.zh: 一颗甜瓜回瞪着我，让我想起从前的好日子……可我不该碰它。连做爱都不行。

lines.en: Rules are meant to be broken.
lines.zh: 规则就是用来打破的。
: 是时候来一发甜瓜了。

lines.en: : Cha cha cha. Intruder alert. Cha cha cha. Intruder alert.
lines.zh: : 恰恰恰。入侵警报。恰恰恰。入侵警报。

lines.en: Uh-oh. It looks like I’ve triggered the freezer’s alarm system. I need to do something quick.
lines.zh: 糟糕。看来我触发了冷冻室的警报系统。我得赶紧做点什么。

lines.en: : Cha cha cha. Intruder alert. Cha cha cha. Intruder alert.
lines.zh: : 恰恰恰。入侵警报。恰恰恰。入侵警报。

lines.en: : I swear it wasn’t for sex.
lines.zh: : 我发誓不是为了做爱。

lines.en: : This melon is reserved for THE PROTOTYPE. Please return the melon and await THE PROTOTYPE.
lines.zh: : 这颗甜瓜是为 THE PROTOTYPE 预留的。请归还甜瓜，静候 THE PROTOTYPE。

lines.en: : What is THE PROTOTYPE? Why can I not use the melon for my own melon-related reasons? This is unfair.
lines.zh: : THE PROTOTYPE 是什么？为什么我不能出于自己的、与甜瓜相关的理由使用这颗甜瓜？这不公平。

lines.en: : Cha cha cha. Intruder alert. Cha cha cha. Intruder alert.
lines.zh: : 恰恰恰。入侵警报。恰恰恰。入侵警报。

lines.en: : {i}Cha cha cha. Intruder alert. Cha cha cha. Intruder alert.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}恰恰恰。入侵警报。恰恰恰。入侵警报。{/i}

lines.en: I slam the freezer door and keep the melon for myself. Even if it’s against the rules.
lines.zh: 我砰地关上冷冻室的门，把甜瓜据为己有。哪怕这违反规定。
{i}你获得了一颗“禁断甜瓜”{/i}
做点别的

lines.en: : I grow tired of these mindless games.
lines.zh: : 我厌倦了这些无聊的游戏。

lines.en: : I need to use my time wisely.
lines.zh: : 我得好好利用时间。

lines.en: An ominous presence crowds the air around the refrigerator.
lines.zh: 一股不祥的气息挤满了冰箱周围的空气。

lines.en: I must endure it if I am to reach my goal.
lines.zh: 我必须忍受它，才能达成目标。

lines.en: I manage to endure the ominous presence and can now freely explore the confines of my fridge.
lines.zh: 我总算忍过了那股不祥的气息，现在可以自由探索冰箱内部了。

lines.en: It’s packed to the brim with some of my favorite ingredients — like milk, bananas, milk, shampoo, and milk.
lines.zh: 里面塞满了我最爱的食材——比如牛奶、香蕉、牛奶、洗发水，还有牛奶。

lines.en: I should add all of them to my inventory so I don’t have to deal with the ominous presence the next time I open the door.
lines.zh: 我该把它们全收进背包，这样下次开门就不用再应付那股不祥的气息了。
{i}你获得了“冰箱里的东西”{/i}

lines.en: It appears there is still one item left in the fridge. But {i}this{/i} item exudes a strange presence as well. And I feel as if adding it to my inventory could result in unfortunate consequences.
lines.zh: 看起来冰箱里还剩一样东西。可{i}这{/i}样东西同样散发着诡异的气息。我觉得要是把它收进背包，可能会招来不幸的后果。

lines.en: Do I want to add it to my inventory anyway?
lines.zh: 我还是要把它收进背包吗？
拿走洗发水

lines.en: : It’s just shampoo. What’s there to be afraid of?
lines.zh: : 只是洗发水而已。有什么好怕的？
{i}你获得了“洗发水”{/i}
: 瞧？也没那么糟嘛。

lines.en: I close the fridge and get on with my day.
lines.zh: 我关上冰箱，继续过我的日子。
别碰它

lines.en: I’ll just leave the shampoo alone. It’s probably for the best.
lines.zh: 我还是别碰那瓶洗发水了。这样大概最好。

lines.en: I close the fridge and get on with my day.
lines.zh: 我关上冰箱，继续过我的日子。
: 又是那瓶洗发水……

lines.en: What do I want to do?
lines.zh: 我想做什么？
拿走洗发水

lines.en: : It’s just shampoo. What’s there to be afraid of?
lines.zh: : 只是洗发水而已。有什么好怕的？
{i}你获得了“洗发水”{/i}
: 瞧？也没那么糟嘛。

lines.en: I close the fridge and get on with my day.
lines.zh: 我关上冰箱，继续过我的日子。
别碰它

lines.en: I’ll just leave the shampoo alone. It’s probably for the best.
lines.zh: 我还是别碰那瓶洗发水了。这样大概最好。

lines.en: I close the fridge and get on with my day.
lines.zh: 我关上冰箱，继续过我的日子。

lines.en: I take a moment to observe the many important notes that either I or someone else left for myself/me.
lines.zh: 我花了一点时间，端详那些我自己、或者别的什么人留给我的许多重要便条。

lines.en: But I can’t help but feel like there may have been a better way to do this...
lines.zh: 可我忍不住觉得，本来也许有更好的做法……

lines.en: Oh well. It is what it is. These notes will be here if I ever need them.
lines.zh: 算了。事情就是这样。这些便条会一直在这儿，等我需要它们的时候。

lines.en: But for now, I should get back to happily living my life.
lines.zh: 不过现在，我该回去幸福地过我的日子了。
我一直很喜欢微波炉。

lines.en: There’s something calming about watching the numbers tick down along with the radioactive hum as the contents inside rapidly change to fit your liking.
lines.zh: 看着数字一跳一跳地往下走，伴着那放射性般的嗡鸣，里面的东西迅速变成你想要的样子——这其中有种让人平静的东西。

lines.en: It’s not like a clock. Though, some microwaves come with clocks built into them.
lines.zh: 它不像时钟。虽然有些微波炉内置了时钟。

lines.en: This is not one of them. This is a good microwave. All it does is cook what I tell it to and burn what I want it to burn.
lines.zh: 这台不是。这是一台好微波炉。它只做我让它煮的东西，也只烧焦我想让它烧焦的东西。

lines.en: I can fit all sorts of things inside of my microwave. I use it to store what I can not hold in my hands.
lines.zh: 我能在微波炉里塞下各种各样的东西。我用它存放那些我捧不住的东西。

lines.en: Sometimes, I’ll turn it on for hours with nothing inside and let its melody sing me to sleep.
lines.zh: 有时候，我会让它空转几个小时，听着它的旋律哄我入睡。

lines.en: The electric company doesn’t like that too much. But I can live without power if I absolutely have to. I’ve done it before.
lines.zh: 电力公司对此颇有微词。不过万不得已，我也能过没电的日子。我又不是没过过。
我只是喜欢那个声音。

lines.en: But I don’t like that I can see myself in its reflection — for it makes me feel like {i}I’m{/i} inside. And there are few things that scare me more than that at this point in life.
lines.zh: 但我不喜欢在它的倒影里看见自己——那让我觉得{i}我{/i}才是里面那个。到了人生这个阶段，能让我更害怕的事已经不多了。

lines.en: It wasn’t always like that, though.
lines.zh: 不过以前不是这样的。
可现在就是这样。

lines.en: $ escapemicrowavecode = renpy.input("Enter the code to open your microwave.")

lines.zh: 门打不开。
再试一次
放弃

lines.en: : On second thought, I don’t need to open the microwave right now.
lines.zh: : 再想想，我现在不需要打开微波炉。
我该改做什么？

lines.en: The door opens and I peer into the microwave to uncover my secret stash of important things.
lines.zh: 门开了，我往微波炉里张望，翻出我那堆藏起来的重要东西。

lines.en: These maggots are my children. I provide them sperm and greasy food so that they may one day grow into strong, faithful human flies.
lines.zh: 这些蛆虫是我的孩子。我为它们提供精子和油腻的食物，好让它们有朝一日长成强壮而忠诚的人形苍蝇。

lines.en: They do not call me “father,” nor do they acknowledge my role in their world. They just gorge themselves on the nutrients I provide and grow.
lines.zh: 它们不叫我“父亲”，也不承认我在它们世界里扮演的角色。它们只是拼命吞吃我提供的养分，然后长大。

lines.en: One day, they will be human enough to learn to speak. And I will teach them all of my favorite words.
lines.zh: 总有一天，它们会足够像人，学会说话。而我会把我最喜欢的词都教给它们。

lines.en: But until then, all I can do is nurture them and create an environment where they are able to thrive.
lines.zh: 但在那之前，我所能做的只有养育它们，为它们创造一个能茁壮成长的环境。

lines.en: It is fun to be God.
lines.zh: 当上帝真有意思。
拿走手机

lines.en: {i}You have obtained a “Personal Cell Phone” and may now use it to make calls.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你获得了一部“私人手机”，现在可以用它打电话了。{/i}

lines.en: : I will see you later, my children.
lines.zh: : 回头见，我的孩子们。

lines.en: : I have many important things to do.
lines.zh: : 我有很多重要的事情要做。

lines.en: : Coffee hey! Coffee ho! Coffee is the place to go!
lines.zh: : 咖啡嘿！咖啡吼！咖啡才是好去处！

lines.en: : Coffee this! Coffee that! Coffee with a dog or cat!
lines.zh: : 咖啡这！咖啡那！咖啡配狗或猫！

lines.en: : Is this some kind of rap song?
lines.zh: : 这是某种说唱吗？

lines.en: : It’s not a rap song, homie! It’s the opening to a long awaited trivia game!
lines.zh: : 才不是说唱，老铁！这是万众期待的问答游戏开场曲！

lines.en: : Answer the questions correctly and you’ll get to be caffeinated {i}and{/i} encapsulated!
lines.zh: : 答对问题，你就能既摄入咖啡因{i}又{/i}被封装起来！
: 被什么封装？
: 愧疚！
: 无止境、折磨人的愧疚！
: 你跑哪儿去了？！
: 你出什么事了？！
: 我们出什么事了？！

lines.en: : I don’t want to do this right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在不想搞这个。

lines.en: : Then answer our questions so you can move on!
lines.zh: : 那就回答我们的问题，好让你继续往前走！

lines.en: : Your grade at the end will determine whether or not you get to proceed!
lines.zh: : 最后的成绩将决定你能不能过关！

lines.en: : Your grade at the end could grant you a key!
lines.zh: : 最后的成绩说不定能给你一把钥匙！

lines.en: : Question one! What is the official mascot of home brewed coffee?
lines.zh: : 第一题！自制咖啡的官方吉祥物是什么？
AeroPress
意式咖啡机
法压壶
渗滤壶

lines.en: : Question two! Which coffee machine is the arch nemesis of the Hario v60?!
lines.zh: : 第二题！哪款咖啡器具是 Hario v60 的死对头？！
The Bee House
Clever Dripper
AeroPress
Kalita Wave

lines.en: : Question three! What’s another name for the Vietnamese dripper?
lines.zh: : 第三题！越南滴滤壶的另一个名字是什么？
Phin
Phan
Phon
Phun

lines.en: : Almost there! Question four — which of these looks like more of a science project than a coffee brewer?
lines.zh: : 快到啦！第四题——以下哪一款看起来更像科学实验装置，而不是咖啡器具？
Kalita Wave
Hario v60
Clever Dripper
AeroPress

lines.en: : And one last question! Which of these coffee brewers is the best for the homies?
lines.zh: : 最后一题！以下哪款咖啡器具最适合兄弟们？
摩卡壶
Chemex 手冲壶
Melitta Ready Set Joe
渗滤壶

lines.en: : So! How do you think you did?
lines.zh: : 好啦！你觉得你答得怎么样？

lines.en: : I’ve never been more prepared for anything in my life.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子从没对任何事这么胸有成竹过。

lines.en: : I’ll drink to that! {i}Coffee{/i} of course — because you passed with flying colors!
lines.zh: : 我敬你一杯！当然是敬{i}咖啡{/i}——因为你以优异的成绩通过了！

lines.en: : Congratulations, Sir! You’re the coffee boy now!
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，老师！你现在是咖啡小子了！

lines.en: : Awesome. This means I get some sort of prize, right?
lines.zh: : 太棒了。也就是说我有奖品拿，对吧？

lines.en: : You sure do! Show him his prize, Molly!
lines.zh: : 当然有！Molly，把奖品拿给他看看！

lines.en: : For receiving 100%% on the coffee quiz, you’ve won...
lines.zh: : 咖啡问答拿到 100%% 满分，你赢得的是……
: 这只绝妙无比的蟑螂！
{i}你获得了一只“绝妙无比的蟑螂”{/i}
: 万岁！一个新朋友！

lines.en: : And that’s not all! You’ll also be receiving...
lines.zh: : 而且还不止这些！你还将获得……
: 这把绝妙无比的钥匙！
{i}你获得了一把“绝妙无比的钥匙”{/i}
: 不错。它开什么的？
: 其实我也不知道。

lines.en: : Yeah, we’re just here to hand stuff out and give your brain something silly to focus on as a distraction from your unending grief!
lines.zh: : 对啊，我们就是来发东西的，给你脑子里塞点蠢事，好让你从那无止境的悲痛里分分神！

lines.en: : Oh, well that’s really nice of you.
lines.zh: : 哦，那你们真是太贴心了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but seeing as answering all of our questions correctly is the trigger that causes us to return to dormancy, we’re going to have to stop responding now.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过既然把所有问题都答对，正是让我们回到休眠状态的触发条件，那我们现在就不能再回应了。
: 什么？这么快？

lines.en: : Come visit us sometime, Sir! We miss you!
lines.zh: : 有空再来看我们啊，老师！我们会想你的！
: 好吧。看来就是这样了。

lines.en: : Well, that’s depressing! Because you failed!
lines.zh: : 好吧，这可真叫人沮丧！因为你没及格！
: 什么？真的吗？

lines.en: : Yes, Sir! Which means that, unfortunately, you’ll be leaving here today without a prize.
lines.zh: : 是的，老师！也就是说，很遗憾，你今天要两手空空地离开这里了。

lines.en: : Can I at least have some coffee?
lines.zh: : 至少给我来杯咖啡吧？
: 不行！我们卖光了。
: 可我明明看见——

lines.en: : {b}SHE SAID WE’RE OUT, YOU FUCKING PUSSY.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}她说卖光了，你这该死的怂包。{/b}

lines.en: I decide to walk away from the coffee maker as the service there was terrible.
lines.zh: 我决定离开咖啡机，毕竟那儿的服务态度实在太差了。
我该改做什么？

lines.en: I crouch down and come face to face with my bottom left cabinet. Even if my bottom left cabinet doesn’t technically have a face.
lines.zh: 我蹲下身，与左下的橱柜面对面。尽管严格来说，我那左下橱柜并没有脸。

lines.en: But when I go to open it, I realize it won’t budge.
lines.zh: 可当我去开它时，我发现它纹丝不动。

lines.en: This is very unfortunate, as I feel an urgent need to get inside the cabinet so I can do something.
lines.zh: 这可太不妙了，因为我迫切地想进到橱柜里面去做点什么。
: 嗯呃！

lines.en: I attempt to pull it open, but fail miserably and pull a muscle in my arm. This is going to hurt for days, I can already tell.
lines.zh: 我试着把它拉开，结果惨败，还拉伤了手臂的肌肉。我能感觉到，这得疼上好几天。

lines.en: Oh well. I guess I’ll have to figure something else out if I want to open that cabinet.
lines.zh: 好吧。想打开那个橱柜，看来我得另想办法了。

lines.en: It looks like my bottom left cabinet is glowing because today is Magical Day.
lines.zh: 看起来我的左下橱柜在发光，因为今天是魔法日。

lines.en: This means I’ll finally be able to open the lock and see what’s inside.
lines.zh: 这意味着我终于能打开锁，看看里面有什么了。

lines.en: : I hope there is some sort of snack!
lines.zh: : 希望里面有某种零食！

lines.en: I place my hand on the lock, releasing the magical seal before pulling the doors open.
lines.zh: 我把手放在锁上，解开魔法封印，然后拉开了柜门。

lines.en: My parrot greets me when I crouch down and put my head inside of his enclosure. I can’t remember the last time I was in here.
lines.zh: 我蹲下身把头探进他的笼子时，我的鹦鹉跟我打了招呼。我不记得上一次进来是什么时候了。

lines.en: I take a look to the left at his coconut crab and see that he has been raising him well.
lines.zh: 我往左边看了看他的椰子蟹，发现他把它养得很好。

lines.en: I’m sure you think it’s strange for one of my pets to have a pet, but that’s just how things work in this house.
lines.zh: 你肯定觉得，我的宠物还养宠物这事很奇怪，可这屋子里就是这么运作的。

lines.en: We all take care of each other and so we can all live happily ever after.
lines.zh: 我们互相照顾，这样大家就能永远幸福地生活下去。

lines.en: I replace my parrot’s bottle of water with a new one- disinfected so his bird liver will not become a home to parasites. And I scratch beneath his chin to show him I love him.
lines.zh: 我给鹦鹉换上一瓶新的水——消过毒，这样他的鸟肝就不会成为寄生虫的温床。我还挠了挠他的下巴，好让他知道我爱他。
: 献祭！献祭！
: 献祭？

lines.en: : A gift for God! A gift for God!
lines.zh: : 给神的礼物！给神的礼物！

lines.en: : I know what a sacrifice is, Parrot. I’m just a little confused about why you’re, you know, {i}parroting{/i} that word.
lines.zh: : 我知道献祭是什么，Parrot。我只是有点搞不懂，你为什么，你知道的，一直在{i}学舌{/i}这个词。

lines.en: : Sacrifice! A gift for God! Sacrifice! A gift for God!
lines.zh: : 献祭！给神的礼物！献祭！给神的礼物！

lines.en: I guess my parrot wants to be sacrificed.
lines.zh: 看来我的鹦鹉想被献祭。
{i}你获得了“鹦鹉”{/i}

lines.en: : I wonder what will become of the coconut crab?
lines.zh: : 不知道那只椰子蟹会怎么样？
: {i}献祭！献祭！{/i}

lines.en: My parrot shrinks itself and flies in circles around my invisible backpack. He’s very happy to be outside his enclosure for once.
lines.zh: 我的鹦鹉缩小了身子，绕着我那看不见的背包飞圈圈。难得能出笼子一趟，他开心极了。
: 你确定吗？

lines.en: : If you’re unhappy, I understand. But I thought we could be a family.
lines.zh: : 如果你不开心，我能理解。可我还以为我们能成为一家人。

lines.en: : Miss her! Miss her! Sacrifice! A gift for God!
lines.zh: : 想她！想她！献祭！给神的礼物！

lines.en: : If that is what must be done, it will be done.
lines.zh: : 如果非这样做不可，那就这样做吧。

lines.en: I crouch before my brand new smart cabinet, complete with four separate smart locks that need to be touched in the correct order for the door to open.
lines.zh: 我蹲在我那崭新的智能橱柜前，上面装着四把独立的智能锁，必须按正确顺序触碰，柜门才会打开。

lines.en: There are warnings drawn all over the cabinet in permanent marker, but I’ve found that their permanence won’t persist through a new coat of paint.
lines.zh: 柜子上到处是用记号笔写的警告，可我发现，那种“永久性”撑不过一层新漆。

lines.en: Or maybe it does and I just can’t see the words I once wrote anymore. I don’t know.
lines.zh: 也可能它撑得住，只是我看不见自己从前写的那些字了。我不知道。

lines.en: The point is, I visit this cabinet a lot. It’s where I keep my spices and it’s where I keep something else.
lines.zh: 重点是，我经常来这个柜子。我在这儿放香料，也在这儿放另一样东西。

lines.en: I just hope I can remember how to open it.
lines.zh: 我只希望我还记得怎么打开它。

lines.en: There’s something very important inside. And leaving it in there unattended would be irresponsible of me to do.
lines.zh: 里面有很重要的东西。就这么放着不管，是我这个人不负责任的表现。

lines.en: I squint my eyes and steady my hands.
lines.zh: 我眯起眼睛，稳住双手。

lines.en: The order in which I will press the tablets is-
lines.zh: 我要按下的顺序是——

lines.en: $ escapebotrightcode = renpy.input("Smart lock deactivation sequence initiated. Please tap lock quadrants in the correct order.")
The combination I entered isn’t valid.
lines.zh: 我输入的组合无效。

lines.en: Should I keep going? Or should I give up instead?
lines.zh: 我要继续吗？还是干脆放弃？
继续
再试一次也无妨。
放弃

lines.en: : On second thought, I don’t have to open that cabinet right now.
lines.zh: : 再想想，我现在不必打开那个橱柜。

lines.en: The angry faces on the tablets turn to happy ones as I manage to enter the correct code.
lines.zh: 随着我输入正确的密码，那些石板上的愤怒面孔变成了笑脸。

lines.en: The reason they are called smart cabinets is because it takes a smart person to open them.
lines.zh: 之所以叫智能橱柜，是因为只有聪明的人才打得开。
我就是那个人。
我是个聪明的男孩。

lines.en: The doors creak as I slowly pull them open.
lines.zh: 我慢慢拉开柜门，门吱呀作响。

lines.en: I wonder when the last time I looked inside was?
lines.zh: 我想不起来，上一次往里面看是什么时候了？

lines.en: This is where I keep my dog, Squirrel.
lines.zh: 我在这儿养着我的狗，Squirrel。

lines.en: I keep her in the smart cabinet because she is a smart girl.
lines.zh: 我把它养在智能橱柜里，因为它是一只聪明的小姑娘。

lines.en: But lately, she has been acting a little strange.
lines.zh: 不过最近，它有点不对劲。

lines.en: There are demons inside of her that allow her to shapeshift, but she is camera-shy and won’t show you while you’re here watching.
lines.zh: 它体内有恶魔，让它能变形，可它很怕镜头，你在这儿看着的时候它不会变给你看。

lines.en: She likes turkey legs and Coca-cola. Her favorite color is yellow and she has been my loyal companion since she crawled in through the vent one day.
lines.zh: 它喜欢火鸡腿和可口可乐。它最喜欢的颜色是黄色。自从有一天它从通风口爬进来，它就一直是我忠诚的伙伴。

lines.en: She was so small back then. And she’s such a big girl now.
lines.zh: 那时候它好小。现在它已经是条大狗了。

lines.en: But the time has come for me to exorcise her demons so she can be at peace.
lines.zh: 但现在是时候为它驱魔了，好让它得到安息。
{i}你获得了“狗”{/i}

lines.en: After stuffing Squirrel into my invisible bag, I notice something peculiar about her cage.
lines.zh: 把 Squirrel 塞进我那看不见的背包之后，我注意到它的笼子有点不对劲。

lines.en: There used to be someone else inside — a pet of her own, if you will. Which you won’t. Because if you would, then I wouldn’t. So I will since you won’t.
lines.zh: 以前里面还住着别的什么——它自己的宠物，如果你愿意这么说的话。你当然不愿意。因为如果你愿意，我就不愿意了。所以既然你不愿意，那我就愿意了。

lines.en: Did you like that fun string of thought-provoking words?
lines.zh: 刚才那段发人深省的有趣文字，你喜欢吗？

lines.en: I’ve been practicing soliloquies so my smartness shines through. Will or won’t you come with me? Will or won’t you try too?
lines.zh: 我一直在练独白，好让我的聪明才智闪闪发光。你愿不愿意跟我走？你愿不愿意也试试？

lines.en: I told you I’m a smart boy. The smartest there is.
lines.zh: 我说了我是个聪明的男孩。世上最聪明的。

lines.en: Everyone here will confirm that for you.
lines.zh: 这里的每个人都会替我作证。

lines.en: All you have to do is ask them.
lines.zh: 你只要去问问他们就知道了。
: 现在怎么办？

lines.en: I gaze down at the floor mat.
lines.zh: 我低头看着地垫。

lines.en: It’s entirely unremarkable apart from a pair of panties that definitely do not belong to me.
lines.zh: 除了一条明显不属于我的内裤，它实在平平无奇。

lines.en: I’m not sure how they got there, but it’s possible they were smuggled in by evil spies who want to make me look like a bad guy in front of my friends.
lines.zh: 我不知道它是怎么到这儿来的，但很可能是邪恶的间谍偷偷放的，想让我在朋友们面前像个坏人。

lines.en: If I touch them, some of my DNA will probably rub off and could incriminate me if they belong to someone who is dead now. So it’s probably best if I leave them alone.
lines.zh: 我要是碰了它，多半会沾上我的 DNA；万一它属于某个已经死了的人，那就会成为我的罪证。所以最好还是别碰。

lines.en: In fact, it’s probably best if I do something else altogether.
lines.zh: 事实上，我大概最好干脆干点别的。

lines.en: I gaze down at the floor mat to discover that it’s covered in fish — likely because it is Fish Day.
lines.zh: 我低头一看，地垫上全是鱼——大概是因为今天是鱼日。

lines.en: One of these could make a good hot pot ingredient, but I should choose carefully since I’m only allowed to take one per week.
lines.zh: 其中一条可以当不错的火锅食材，不过我得仔细挑，因为我一周只能拿一条。

lines.en: I’m not really sure why. Those are just the rules. And as a law-abiding citizen, I must follow them.
lines.zh: 我也不太清楚为什么。规矩就是规矩。作为一个守法公民，我必须遵守。

lines.en: Which fish do I want to take?
lines.zh: 我要拿哪条鱼？
长嘴珊瑚鱼
{i}你获得了一条“长嘴珊瑚鱼”{/i}
: 太爽了。
丑角鲀鱼
{i}你获得了一条“丑角鲀鱼”{/i}
: 太爽了。
蓝带神仙鱼
{i}你获得了一条“蓝带神仙鱼”{/i}
: 太爽了。
小丑鱼
{i}你获得了一条“小丑鱼”{/i}
: 太爽了。
狮子鱼
{i}你获得了一条“狮子鱼”{/i}
: 太爽了。
旗鲷鱼
{i}你获得了一条“旗鲷鱼”{/i}
: 太爽了。
鹦嘴鱼
{i}你获得了一条“鹦嘴鱼”{/i}
: 太爽了。

lines.en: : I can’t wait to try adding this to my hot pot.
lines.zh: : 我等不及想把它下进火锅里试试。

lines.en: I live a simple life here, but I wouldn’t be able to do that if it wasn’t for my trusty schedule.
lines.zh: 我在这里过着简单的生活，可要是没有我那可靠的日程表，我也过不上这种日子。

lines.en: With over six days in every week, I can do as many things as I want, whenever I want to do them.
lines.zh: 一周有六天多，我想做多少事就做多少事，想什么时候做就什么时候做。

lines.en: Sometimes, someone leaves me flowers. But the flowers block the view of my schedule, so I often push them away.
lines.zh: 有时候，有人会给我留花。可花挡住了我的日程表，所以我经常把它们推开。

lines.en: They always come back immediately, though. It’s unfair.
lines.zh: 可它们总是立刻又回来了。这不公平。
看着吧。
: 第一步——完成。

lines.en: : Step two requires waiting for them to respawn and-
lines.zh: : 第二步需要等它们刷新，然后——
{i}你获得了一把“鲜花钥匙”{/i}

lines.en: : Wait, what? That’s never happened before.
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？以前从没发生过这种事。

lines.en: : The “Flower Key” can be used to open something in this room! Go exploring and find out what!
lines.zh: : “鲜花钥匙”可以用来打开这个房间里的某样东西！去探索一下，看看是什么！

lines.en: : Just don’t use too many of them or you’ll wind up somewhere you don’t want to be.
lines.zh: : 只是别用太多把，不然你会落到自己不想去的地方。

lines.en: : You’re supposed to stay here. This is where you’re safe.
lines.zh: : 你应该待在这里。这里才是你安全的地方。

lines.en: : I know that. I’m not going to leave. I have no reason to leave. I’m happy here.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我不会走的。我没有理由离开。我在这里很幸福。

lines.en: The voice on the PA stops responding.
lines.zh: 广播里的声音不再回应。
然后，花瓶又刷新了。
这种事总是发生。
这就是我讨厌花的原因。

lines.en: I push the vase aside again to get another look at the schedule.
lines.zh: 我再次把花瓶推开，好看一眼日程表。
然后它又回来了。

lines.en: I should do something else instead.
lines.zh: 我该改做点别的。
: 该看日历了。
: 时间到了。
我该做点别的。

lines.en: I stare up at my TV and begin to reminisce about all of the spectacular local programming I’ve watched on it over the last few years.
lines.zh: 我抬头盯着电视，开始怀念这几年来在它上面看过的那些精彩的本地节目。

lines.en: It seems that, every day, something new is coming out.
lines.zh: 似乎每一天都有新节目出来。

lines.en: Whether it be Untitled Children’s Show or Nighttime Banana Battle, there’s always something entertaining to keep me occupied.
lines.zh: 不管是《无题儿童节目》还是《夜间香蕉大乱斗》，总有好玩的东西让我不闲着。

lines.en: There’s always something to keep my mind from wandering.
lines.zh: 总有东西能让我不去胡思乱想。

lines.en: I lean back in my chair and wipe the drool from my chin, prepared to zone out for one more night on the way to indefinite indecision.
lines.zh: 我往椅背上一靠，擦掉下巴上的口水，准备再放空一晚，就这样走向那无休止的犹豫不决。

lines.en: Carry me away, old friend. To better days in better places.
lines.zh: 带我走吧，老朋友。带我去更好的地方、更好的日子。
换台

lines.en: : Oh, look. Untitled Children’s Show is on.
lines.zh: : 哦，瞧。《无题儿童节目》在播。
别管电视

lines.en: I decide against watching TV. I’ll do something else instead.
lines.zh: 我决定不看电视。改做点别的。
换台

lines.en: : I don’t want to change the channel. I like this show.
lines.zh: : 我不想换台。我喜欢这个节目。
别管电视

lines.en: I like this show, so I’ll keep this on for a while.
lines.zh: 我喜欢这个节目，就让它再放一会儿吧。

lines.en: I gaze into the hot pot. It beckons to be fed.
lines.zh: 我望着火锅。它在召唤我去喂它。

lines.en: What ingredients do I want to add to it?
lines.zh: 我想往里面加什么食材？
FoodCo. 汤底块

lines.en: Every hot pot needs a good base, and there’s no better base than FoodCo’s famous hot pot roux.
lines.zh: 每锅火锅都需要好汤底，而没有比 FoodCo 著名的火锅汤底块更好的汤底了。

lines.en: I drop the premade roux into the pot and it immediately begins to crackle and fizzle, the way all good roux does.
lines.zh: 我把预制汤底块丢进锅里，它立刻开始噼啪作响，所有好汤底块都是这样的。

lines.en: I can’t wait to eat this.
lines.zh: 我等不及想吃了。
西瓜

lines.en: I know I wasn’t supposed to touch this watermelon, but it would be a crime to keep it away from my hot pot.
lines.zh: 我知道我不该碰这颗西瓜，可要是不让它进我的火锅，那简直是犯罪。

lines.en: A little bit wouldn’t hurt, right?
lines.zh: 来一点点也没关系吧？

lines.en: I bite off a chunk of the watermelon, but don’t manage to get much since watermelons are surprisingly hard to bite through.
lines.zh: 我咬下一大块西瓜，可没咬到多少——西瓜出乎意料地难咬。

lines.en: I spit what I {i}am{/i} able to get into the pot and it quickly dissolves.
lines.zh: 我把{i}能{/i}咬到的那点吐进锅里，它很快溶解了。

lines.en: This will be my first time putting watermelon in my hot pot, so I sure hope it doesn’t ruin everything.
lines.zh: 这还是我第一次往火锅里放西瓜，但愿它不会毁了这一锅。
鹦鹉 Parrot

lines.en: : {i}A gift for God! Sacrifice! Miss her! Miss her!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}给神的礼物！献祭！想她！想她！{/i}

lines.en: : I’m sorry it had to end like this.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉事情会这样收场。

lines.en: : I hope we can be friends in our next life.
lines.zh: : 希望来世我们还能做朋友。

lines.en: I drop my parrot into the hot pot and it bursts into flames.
lines.zh: 我把鹦鹉丢进火锅，它一下子烧了起来。

lines.en: It’s tragic watching something you grew yourself fade away right before your very eyes, but it’s also kind of beautiful in a way.
lines.zh: 看着自己一手养大的东西在眼前消逝，很悲惨，可某种意义上也挺美。

lines.en: I know he’ll be going somewhere better now. And I know this is what he wanted.
lines.zh: 我知道他现在要去更好的地方了。我也知道这正是他想要的。

lines.en: All I can do is give him the respect he deserves and consume him entirely.
lines.zh: 我所能做的，就是给他应有的尊重，然后把他完全吃掉。
狗狗 Squirrel

lines.en: My dog stares up at me as I take her into my arms — fearless.
lines.zh: 我把狗抱进怀里，它抬头望着我——毫无惧色。

lines.en: She trusts me with her life and is a loyal companion.
lines.zh: 它把性命托付给我，是个忠诚的伙伴。

lines.en: But I know what I must do in order to heal her and purge the demons from her body.
lines.zh: 但我知道，要治好它、把恶魔从它体内驱走，我必须做什么。

lines.en: I will take them into myself. And in doing so, I will make her whole.
lines.zh: 我会把那些恶魔接进自己体内。这样做，就能让它重归完整。

lines.en: She looks at me again. Then down at the hot pot.
lines.zh: 它又看了我一眼。然后低头看向火锅。

lines.en: I close my eyes and drop her in.
lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，把它放了进去。

lines.en: She whimpers. Cries. But it doesn’t last long.
lines.zh: 它呜咽。哀叫。但没持续多久。
痛苦结束了。
冰箱里的东西

lines.en: I empty out the contents of my fridge into the hot pot because recipes are for frauds and real chefs cook with heart.
lines.zh: 我把冰箱里的东西一股脑倒进火锅，因为菜谱是给骗子看的，真正的大厨用心做菜。

lines.en: The problem here is that I do not have any heart left and all I can do is hope that something in this batch of ingredients will work as a viable substitute.
lines.zh: 问题在于，我已经没有心了，只能指望这批食材里有什么东西能当替代品。

lines.en: The ingredients dissolve- apart from the banana. This fruit is surprisingly resilient and I wonder what it is about the peel that makes it impervious to flame damage.
lines.zh: 食材都溶了——除了那根香蕉。这水果出奇地顽强，我琢磨着，到底是皮上的什么东西让它不怕火烧。

lines.en: I remove the peel, sensing that it will not be dissolving any time soon- but it seems as if the rest of the ingredients successfully have.
lines.zh: 我把皮捞了出来，感觉它一时半会儿溶不掉——不过其他食材似乎都成功溶了。
蜈蚣

lines.en: The centipede I stole from the vent has been biting through my invisible backpack ever since I picked it up, and the time has come to stop the damage.
lines.zh: 我从通风口偷来的那只蜈蚣，从我把它捡起来起就一直啃着我那看不见的背包，是时候止损了。

lines.en: I pluck it out of my backpack, squeezing its head between my thumb and forefinger, before dropping it into the pot and watching it flail around.
lines.zh: 我把它从背包里揪出来，用拇指和食指捏住它的头，然后丢进锅里，看着它挣扎。

lines.en: I’m not sure if insects feel pain. I think I recall someone close to me saying they don’t.
lines.zh: 我不确定昆虫会不会痛。我记得有个亲近的人说过它们不会。

lines.en: And even though I was not particularly fond of this temporary friend, I hope he did not suffer as he dissolved into nothing.
lines.zh: 虽然我并不怎么喜欢这位临时的朋友，但我希望它化为乌有的时候没有受苦。
狮子鱼

lines.en: I think I heard somewhere that lionfish are poisonous- but I’m pretty sure that’s only in regard to other fish.
lines.zh: 我好像在哪儿听说狮子鱼有毒——不过我敢肯定那只是对其他鱼而言。

lines.en: If that is true, I did marine life a favor by making this selection during Fish Day- and everyone should be proud of me for adding it to my hot pot.
lines.zh: 如果真是这样，那我在鱼日选了它，算是帮了海洋生物一个忙——大家应该为我把它下进火锅而感到骄傲。

lines.en: The lionfish slips out of my hands and splashes into the pot, making a new home for itself inside of boiling water.
lines.zh: 狮子鱼从我手里滑了出去，扑通一声落进锅里，在滚水里给自己安了个新家。

lines.en: It doesn’t last long and dissolves before I can even say goodbye.
lines.zh: 它没撑多久，我还没来得及说再见就溶掉了。
长嘴珊瑚鱼

lines.en: I drop the coralfish into the hot pot. But when it doesn’t dissolve, I realize I’ve made a mistake.
lines.zh: 我把珊瑚鱼丢进火锅。可它没溶，我这才意识到自己搞错了。

lines.en: I manage to pull it out before it contaminates the rest of the pot, but I’ll have to wait until the next Fish Day for another one.
lines.zh: 我赶在它污染整锅之前把它捞了出来，不过我得等到下一个鱼日才能再拿一条。

lines.en: After ruining the hot pot, I'm too depressed to do anything else and wind up going to sleep.
lines.zh: 把火锅搞砸之后，我沮丧得什么都做不下去，最后干脆去睡了。
小丑鱼

lines.en: I drop the clownfish into the hot pot. But when it doesn’t dissolve, I realize I’ve made a mistake.
lines.zh: 我把小丑鱼丢进火锅。可它没溶，我这才意识到自己搞错了。

lines.en: I manage to pull it out before it contaminates the rest of the pot, but I’ll have to wait until the next Fish Day for another one.
lines.zh: 我赶在它污染整锅之前把它捞了出来，不过我得等到下一个鱼日才能再拿一条。

lines.zh: 把火锅搞砸之后，我沮丧得什么都做不下去，最后干脆去睡了。
完成火锅

lines.en: : Everything’s looking good so far...but I think I’m still missing something.
lines.zh: : 目前看起来都不错……不过我觉得还差了点什么。

lines.en: I’ve had a hangnail for several days. It’s been bothering me to no end.
lines.zh: 我的手指倒刺已经长了好几天，烦死我了。

lines.en: Bracing myself for the pain it’s sure to bring, I place it in my mouth and tear away at it- removing some of the flesh from my finger in the process.
lines.zh: 我做好了挨痛的准备，把手指放进嘴里咬住倒刺一撕——顺带扯下了指尖的一点肉。

lines.en: This is the final ingredient I need for the hot pot.
lines.zh: 这就是我火锅所需的最后一样食材。

lines.en: Sucking the blood from my finger, I drop the hangnail in and-
lines.zh: 我吮着手指上的血，把那片倒刺丢了进去，然后——
{i}你获得了一把“美味钥匙”{/i}

lines.en: : A delicious key? But where did all of my ingredients go? This was supposed to be a delicious hot pot.
lines.zh: : 美味钥匙？可我的食材都去哪儿了？这本来该是一锅美味的火锅啊。

lines.en: I stare down at the hot pot once more. It still beckons to be fed- but I have nothing left to give it.
lines.zh: 我又低头看向火锅。它依旧在召唤我去喂它——可我已经没什么能给的了。

lines.en: I will just have to starve to death.
lines.zh: 我大概只能饿死了。
停止加料

lines.en: : I think that’s enough for now. I’ll come back when I have more ingredients to add.
lines.zh: : 我觉得差不多了。等我有更多食材再来。
: 现在怎么办？
: 你好，Barbara。
: 你好，Akira。

lines.en: This is Barbara with midnight eyes. I talk to her when I get lonely.
lines.zh: 这就是有着午夜般眼眸的 Barbara。我寂寞的时候就找她说话。

lines.en: She’s under strict orders (from me) to never open herself up because I can’t handle what she holds.
lines.zh: （我）给她下过严格的命令，永远不许把自己打开，因为我承受不了她肚子里装着的东西。

lines.en: This isn’t just because she’s the ideal woman, but because I used to hide things inside of her that I’m not allowed to have anymore.
lines.zh: 这不光因为她是理想的女人，还因为我曾经在她体内藏过一些现在不许我再拥有的东西。

lines.en: Keeping me away is what’s best for everyone.
lines.zh: 把我挡在外面，对所有人都是最好的。

lines.en: I am a protector now. A keeper of keys and creatures and an icon of righteousness.
lines.zh: 我现在是个守护者。钥匙与生灵的看管人，正义的化身。

lines.en: Additionally, I have learned to treat the female species better — and have authored several books on how to succeed when it comes to “getting the girl.”
lines.zh: 此外，我学会了更好地对待女性这一物种——还写了好几本关于如何成功“追到女孩子”的书。

lines.en: I will show you some of my strategies today. Because, like yesterday and days before, I’m lonely.
lines.zh: 今天我就给你们展示几招我的策略。因为就跟昨天和之前的每一天一样，我很寂寞。
我永远都是寂寞的。

lines.en: But that’s okay so long as I have Barbara.
lines.zh: 不过只要有 Barbara 在，就没关系。

lines.en: : Barbara, are you free right now?
lines.zh: : Barbara，你现在方便吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but you know I can’t let you inside no matter how hard you try.
lines.zh: : 方便，可你知道，不管你怎么努力，我都不会让你进来的。

lines.en: : I understand that, but I have to prove to everyone that I’m not a liar.
lines.zh: : 我明白，可我必须向所有人证明我不是个骗子。

lines.en: : But you are a liar, Akira. All you ever do is lie. Even after all this time. You’ve never learned at all.
lines.zh: : 可你就是个骗子，Akira。你除了撒谎什么都不会。这么久了还是老样子。你一点长进都没有。

lines.en: : What’s inside of me must {i}stay{/i} inside of me or you’re going to hurt someone again. And that someone could be you. I don’t want that.
lines.zh: : 我体内的东西{i}必须{/i}留在我体内，否则你又会去伤害别人。而那个人可能就是你自己。我不想那样。
硬来

lines.en: : Listen, Barbara. You’re a cabinet. You don’t have the authority to tell me what I can and can’t do.
lines.zh: : 听着，Barbara。你是个橱柜。你没有资格告诉我什么能做、什么不能做。

lines.en: : Oh, no. Hell no. You didn’t just call me a cabinet.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。绝对不行。你刚才居然叫我橱柜。

lines.en: : But I did. And if you know what’s best for you, you’ll save both of us the hassle and-
lines.zh: : 我确实叫了。你要是识相，就该省了我们俩的麻烦，然后——

lines.en: : Give it a rest, Akira. We’re done here.
lines.zh: : 省省吧，Akira。到此为止。
表示理解
施展魅力
: {i}这样{/i}能让你改变主意吗？

lines.en: I begin to flex my muscles as Barbara is typically interested in that sort of thing.
lines.zh: 我开始秀起肌肉，因为 Barbara 通常对这种事感兴趣。
: 那这样呢？

lines.en: I flex my penis as well to show her how strong and experienced it is and how I can flex anything if I try hard enough.
lines.zh: 我还把阴茎也绷了一下，好让她看看它有多强壮、多有经验，以及只要我够努力，什么都能绷起来。

lines.en: : I can’t let you in, Akira.
lines.zh: : 我不能让你进来，Akira。

lines.en: : But I {i}want{/i} to be in, Barbara. Look at my strong penis with your midnight eyes.
lines.zh: : 可我{i}想{/i}进去，Barbara。用你那午夜般的眼眸看看我强壮的阴茎吧。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, I just...can’t let it happen.
lines.zh: : 对不起，我只是……不能让它发生。

lines.en: : I understand your concern, but things are different now. I can handle all of those things you used to worry about.
lines.zh: : 我理解你的担心，可现在不一样了。你从前担心的那些事，我都能应付。

lines.en: : Oh, please. I bet you can’t even {i}name{/i} any of those “things.”
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。我打赌你连那些“事”的{i}名字{/i}都说不出来。

lines.en: : Does it really make a difference if I can or can’t? The fact of the matter is, I’m stronger than you think I am. I can handle anything you throw my way.
lines.zh: : 我说得出来还是说不出来，真有区别吗？事实是，我比你以为的更坚强。你丢过来的任何事我都能扛。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? So if I were to ask you to take me on a {i}real{/i} date, where would we go?
lines.zh: : 是吗？那要是我让你带我去一次{i}真正的{/i}约会，我们会去哪儿？
五金店

lines.en: : Obviously, we’d go to the hardware store and pick up a few extra...accessories for you.
lines.zh: : 显然，我们会去五金店，给你买几样额外的……配件。

lines.en: : I was trying to allude to that meaning lingerie, but I’m not really sure if it worked or not.
lines.zh: : 我本来想暗示的是内衣，不过我也不确定有没有奏效。

lines.en: : I can’t believe you. You really thought that was going to work? That I’d just {i}ignore{/i} how you always wind up reducing me to my {i}appearance{/i} rather than what’s on the inside?
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你。你真以为这招管用？以为我会{i}无视{/i}你每次都把我简化成我的{i}外表{/i}，而不是我的内在？

lines.en: : In my defense, I am specifically after what’s “on the inside” right now, so I don’t think that argument holds up very well.
lines.zh: : 替我自己说句话，我现在图的偏偏就是“内在”，所以我觉得你这个论点站不住脚。

lines.en: : And I don’t think this {i}date{/i} holds up very well, so you’re going to have to try again when you feel like less of an asshole.
lines.zh: : 我也觉得这次{i}约会{/i}站不住脚，所以等你没那么混蛋了再来试吧。
意大利餐厅
情侣水疗度假

lines.en: : I’d have to take you on a couple’s spa retreat. I think we could both use a little time to relax and unwind.
lines.zh: : 那我得带你去情侣水疗度假。我觉得我们俩都需要点时间放松一下。

lines.en: : That’s a nice idea, but I can’t really imagine being able to relax and unwind around so many other people who look nothing like me.
lines.zh: : 主意不错，可我实在想象不出，在一群跟我长得完全不同的人旁边，我怎么能放松得下来。

lines.en: : Midnight eyes are a gift from God and no one ever understands that. And if that’s not enough, I’m tired of seeing through everyone. I’m tired of my X-ray vision.
lines.zh: : 午夜般的眼眸是神的恩赐，可从来没人懂。如果这还不够，那我告诉你，我看透所有人已经看腻了。我受够了我的透视能力。

lines.en: : I love your X-ray vision, Barbara. It’s one of my favorite things about you.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你的透视能力，Barbara。这是你最让我喜欢的地方之一。

lines.en: : I appreciate that, Akira. But that’s just not the sort of date I’m interested in.
lines.zh: : 我很感激你这么说，Akira。可这真的不是我感兴趣的那种约会。

lines.en: : You like Italian food, don’t you? Maybe we could hit up a cozy Italian restaurant with neutral lighting and some fine mustachioed gentlemen?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢意大利菜，对吧？要不我们去一家灯光柔和、有几位蓄着漂亮小胡子的绅士的温馨意大利餐厅？

lines.en: : Hmm...I {i}do{/i} love neutral lighting. And mustaches.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我{i}确实{/i}喜欢柔和的灯光。还有小胡子。

lines.en: : See? I’m not as inept as you think. I can put together a solid date if I really want to.
lines.zh: : 瞧？我没你想的那么无能。只要我真想，也能安排一场像样的约会。

lines.en: : Akira, why do you even want to remove my innards in the first place? Doing that will kill me. You {i}know{/i} it will. It’s part of the pact we made when you gifted me sentience.
lines.zh: : Akira，你到底为什么想把我的内脏取出来？那样做会杀了我。你{i}清楚{/i}会。这是你赋予我意识时我们立下的契约的一部分。

lines.en: : If you really want the truth...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 如果你真想知道实话……我不知道。

lines.en: : I have no idea what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道自己在做什么。
: Akira……

lines.en: : But it’s {i}because{/i} I have no idea what I’m doing that I have to do {i}something.{/i} You know?
lines.zh: : 可{i}正因为{/i}我不知道自己在做什么，我才必须做点{i}什么{/i}。你明白吗？

lines.en: : Maybe I can face it now? Maybe I really {i}can{/i} embrace the past instead of curling up into a ball every night and waking up in a puddle of my own spit.
lines.zh: : 也许我现在能面对了？也许我真的{i}能{/i}拥抱过去了，而不是每天晚上蜷成一团，然后在一滩自己的口水中醒来。
: 也可能我还是不行。
: 我不知道。

lines.en: : But I’m never going to find out if you don’t {i}let me in.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可要是你{i}不让我进去{/i}，我永远也不会知道。
: 我最喜欢的电影是什么？

lines.en: : Then we need to change that right away. The only reason I’m calling it your favorite movie now is-

lines.en: : Are you going to spill out your guts now?

lines.en: : It’s exactly what I wanted to hear.

lines.en: : I can die in peace now.
lines.zh: : 现在我可以安心地死了。

: Barbara，等等——

lines.en: : My consciousness is fading...what is it?...

lines.en: There is also ammunition and health potion in case I wind up taking too much damage in Barbara’s absence.

lines.zh: : 能麻烦你把它寄到我家吗？

lines.en: : Are you sure, Akira? You told me to only send it over when you were absolutely certain. You gave me very strict orders.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗，Akira？你跟我说过，只有你百分之百确定的时候才能寄。你给我的指示非常严格。

lines.en: : I’m sure. I have a feeling I’ll need it soon.
lines.zh: : 我确定。我有预感，很快就会需要它。

lines.en: : In that case, I’ll deliver it to the post office myself. But you mustn’t get mad at me if you change your mind by the end of the day since I’ll be dropping it off very shortly!
lines.zh: : 那样的话，我会亲自送到邮局。不过要是你当天就改了主意，可别生我的气——因为我很快就会把它送过去！
: 不会的。谢谢。
: 其他一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : Not much has changed. How are you, though? You sound good.
lines.zh: : 没什么变化。倒是你怎么样？听你声音挺不错。

lines.en: : I’m more than good. I’m wonderful. I’m cherishing every moment of life and- ah. Akira, I have a call on the other line. May I put you on hold for a moment?
lines.zh: : 我何止是不错。我好极了。我珍惜生命中的每一刻——啊。Akira，我另一条线路有电话进来。能请你稍等一下吗？

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’ll just call  again some other time.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我改天再打给你。

lines.en: : Aww...okay. Thank you for calling, though! It was nice hearing your voice again!
lines.zh: : 啊……好吧。不过还是谢谢你打来！能再听到你的声音真好！
: 我也是。再见，Yasu。
: {i}再见，Akira！{/i}
我挂了电话。

lines.en: My package from New Hope should get here soon.
lines.zh: 新希望寄来的包裹应该很快就到了。

lines.en: : Thank you, {b}AKIRA ARAKAWA,{/b} for calling the Church of New Hope — Kumon-mi’s premier religious learning center.
lines.zh: : 感谢{b}AKIRA ARAKAWA{/b}致电新希望教会——Kumon-mi 首屈一指的宗教学习中心。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, we can’t get to the phone right now. But if you’d like someone to call you back.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，我们现在无法接听电话。如果您希望有人回电，请……

lines.en: I hang up the phone and decide to try something else.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，决定试试别的。
: Sakaki-bar-a。自取还是外送？
: 外送。

lines.en: : Ah! Good timing. I was actually just about to call you.
lines.zh: : 啊！来得正好。我正准备给你打电话呢。

lines.en: : I was thinking of dropping by for a couple hours tonight and I was wondering if there was anything you needed from the grocery store.
lines.zh: : 我想今晚过去待两个小时，顺便问问你有没有什么要从杂货店带的。

lines.en: : I’m okay. Just the usual things are fine.
lines.zh: : 我没事。老样子就行。
: 收到！~
: 你今天听起来心情不错啊。
: 哈哈哈……是吗？我倒想知道为什么。

lines.en: : {i}Surely{/i} it doesn’t have anything to do with my plans after work.
lines.zh: : {i}想必{/i}跟我下班后的计划毫无关系吧。

lines.en: : Is business okay? How’s your mom?
lines.zh: : 生意还好吗？你妈妈怎么样？

lines.en: : Still recovering, but good. Her hair’s starting to grow back. You want to talk to her?
lines.zh: : 还在恢复，不过挺好的。她的头发开始长回来了。你要跟她说两句吗？

lines.en: : No, that’s fine. I’ll take your word for it.
lines.zh: : 不，不用了。我相信你说的。

lines.en: : If you say so! I’ve gotta run, though. I have a few more tables to check on before I clock out. But I’ll see you soon, okay?
lines.zh: : 你说好就好！不过我得挂了。下班前还有几桌要照看。我们很快见，好吗？
: 回头见。
: 特快专递！一个 Sana~

lines.en: : And some other things, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概还有些别的东西。

lines.en: : Sorry for making you do all this again. I’ll pay you back when I can.
lines.zh: : 抱歉又让你做这些。等我有了钱会还你的。

lines.en: : It’s fine. Don’t even worry about it. Anything I can do to help.
lines.zh: : 没事。别放在心上。能帮上忙就好。

lines.en: : Are you eating well? Bathing? Need me to whip something up for you? My apron should still be here, right?
lines.zh: : 你吃得好吗？洗澡了吗？要不要我给你做点什么？我的围裙应该还在这儿吧？

lines.en: : It is, but I can eat when you’re gone. I don’t want to make you spend what little time you have cooking for me. The ingredients are more than enough.
lines.zh: : 在的，不过你走了我再吃就行。我不想让你把本来就少的时间花在给我做饭上。食材已经够多了。
: 你说好就好~
: 哦，还有这个。
{i}你获得了一把“神秘钥匙”{/i}
: 一把钥匙？

lines.en: : Yeah. I found it in one of my pockets after leaving here the other night. I figured it was yours. Was I wrong?
lines.zh: : 嗯。前天晚上离开这儿之后，我在口袋里发现了它。我猜是你的。我猜错了吗？

lines.en: : I’m not really sure...I’ll hang onto it, though.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定……不过我会留着的。

lines.en: : You never know when these things might come in handy.
lines.zh: : 谁也说不准这些东西什么时候派得上用场。
: 哈哈哈……是啊。谁也说不准。
: 那个，呃……

lines.en: : Is there anything {i}else{/i} I can do for you?
lines.zh: : 还有{i}别的{/i}我能为你做的吗？
: 也许来点……{i}坏坏的{/i}？

lines.en: : Sometimes, it feels like you only use me for my body.
lines.zh: : 有时候我觉得，你只是在用我的身体。
: 嘿嘿！有时候确实是~

lines.en: : But other times, you’re a very special person to me.
lines.zh: : 但其他时候，你对我来说是个非常特别的人。

lines.en: : You know that, right? That this isn’t {i}just{/i} for fun.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，对吧？我们之间{i}不单{/i}是为了玩玩。
: 我想是的。
: Sensei，看着我。
: 看。着。我。
: 我爱你。好吗？

lines.en: : Now, please excuse me while I put these things away and then take all of my clothes off. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 那么，请允许我先把这些东西收好，然后把衣服全脱了。谢谢。

lines.en: She does exactly what she says she will.
lines.zh: 她说到做到。

lines.en: She climbs on top of me and, with steady hands, guides my shaft into her body.
lines.zh: 她爬到我身上，用沉稳的双手把我的肉棒引进她的身体。

lines.en: We kiss. Repeatedly. But I’m not sure if I can call it “passionately.”
lines.zh: 我们接吻。一次接一次。但我不确定能不能称之为“充满激情”。

lines.en: The chair creaks and squeaks as it dances across the tile floor. I can see her trying to steady it with the tips of her toes as she straddles my body.
lines.zh: 椅子在瓷砖地板上滑动，吱呀作响。她骑在我身上，我看得见她踮着脚尖想稳住它。

lines.en: But she gives up- and we fall to the ground.
lines.zh: 可她放弃了——我们一起摔到了地上。

lines.en: She pins me down by the shoulders...bites my neck...and in turning away to give her a better shot at my jugular vein, something under the stove catches my eye.
lines.zh: 她按住我的肩膀……咬我的脖子……我偏过头好让她更容易咬到我的颈静脉，就在这时，炉子底下有什么东西映入了我的眼帘。

lines.en: It’s the bone of a ring finger I couldn’t bring myself to get rid of.
lines.zh: 是我始终狠不下心扔掉的一根无名指的骨头。

lines.en: My eyes lock onto it as Sana squeezes every last drop of cum out of this decaying body.
lines.zh: 我的目光死死盯着它，而 Sana 正把这具腐朽身体里的最后一滴精液都榨出来。
我们最后一次接吻。

lines.en: She puts her clothes back on.
lines.zh: 她把衣服穿了回去。

lines.en: And she heads back home...just like she always does.
lines.zh: 然后她回家了……就像她一贯的那样。
{i}这一天结束了。{/i}

lines.en: : Thank you for calling Sakaki-bar-a! Please hold!
lines.zh: : 感谢致电 Sakaki-bar-a！请稍候！
: 我晚点再打吧。

lines.en: : Thank you for calling FoodCo. We can’t make it to the phone right now. But if you would like to place an order for delivery the following business day, please press the corresponding-
lines.zh: : 感谢致电 FoodCo。我们暂时无法接听电话。如果您想在下一个工作日下单外送，请按相应的——

lines.en: I press the number 7 and order box of FoodCo’s famous hot pot roux before the automated system cycles through its options.
lines.zh: 我在自动系统循环播完选项之前按下数字 7，订了一盒 FoodCo 著名的火锅汤底块。

lines.en: As you can tell, I’ve memorized the message by now.
lines.zh: 看得出来，这段语音我早背下来了。

lines.en: It wasn’t intentional, just the way things wound up playing out.
lines.zh: 这不是我故意的，只是事情就这么发展成了这样。

lines.en: But the good news is I’m able to somewhat feed myself now. And the betters news is that, soon, I’ll be making a delicious hot pot with some of FoodCo’s famous hot pot roux.
lines.zh: 好消息是，我现在多少能喂饱自己了。而更好的消息是，很快我就能用 FoodCo 著名的火锅汤底块做一锅美味的火锅了。
一定会很棒。

lines.en: : Thank you for calling FoodCo. Please note that we will be closed indefinitely due to investigations connecting our facility to the recent outbreak of Lynks Disease.
lines.zh: : 感谢致电 FoodCo。请注意，因调查将本厂与近期 Lynks 病的暴发相关联，我们将无限期停业。

lines.en: : Thank you for remaining a loyal customer and have a nice day.
lines.zh: : 感谢您一直以来的惠顾，祝您度过愉快的一天。
: 该死。现在怎么办？

lines.en: : Thank you for calling Tojo Ramen. How may I help you?
lines.zh: : 感谢致电 Tojo Ramen。请问需要什么？

lines.en: I’ll never understand why that ramen shop always hangs up on me...
lines.zh: 我永远搞不懂，那家拉面店为什么老挂我电话……

lines.en: : We're sorry. The number you have dialed is not in service. Please hang up and try again.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，您拨打的号码是空号。请挂机后重拨。
: 该死。

lines.en: I’m forced to hang up the phone.
lines.zh: 我不得不挂了电话。
把手机收起来
: 现在怎么办？

lines.en: Do I really want to do that?
lines.zh: 我真的想这么做吗？

lines.en: Do I really want to leave?
lines.zh: 我真的想离开吗？
为什么？

lines.en: Nothing good ever comes from leaving the house.
lines.zh: 离开这所房子，从来不会有好事。

lines.en: I’m supposed to stay in here. That’s my job now.
lines.zh: 我应该待在这里面。这就是我现在的职责。
我有东西要守护。

lines.en: I have {i}myself{/i} to protect. And I can’t do that if I don’t know what to expect.
lines.zh: 我还要守护{i}我自己{/i}。而如果我不知道会遇上什么，就做不到这一点。

lines.en: This is my sanctuary. My heaven. My castle — where I sit atop a throne of unrealized depravity and slowly decay as the world continues to spin without me.
lines.zh: 这是我的圣所。我的天堂。我的城堡——我坐在由未曾实现的堕落铸成的王座上，缓缓腐朽，任这世界继续自转，与我无关。

lines.en: I have forfeited the right to participate in such motion. I have forfeited {i}everything{/i} because that is what needed to be done to quiet the endless quaking of this never-waking mind.
lines.zh: 我已经放弃了参与这种运转的权利。我放弃了{i}一切{/i}，因为只有这样才能平息这颗永不苏醒的头脑里无休止的震颤。

lines.en: But it all feels so inert.
lines.zh: 可这一切都显得如此死寂。
这到底是好，还是坏？

lines.en: Which way’s right and which way’s left and {i}why{/i} do I continue to struggle so hard if I {i}know{/i} that the only reward I’ll receive for doing so is pain?
lines.zh: 哪边是右，哪边是左，既然我{i}明明知道{/i}唯一的回报只有痛苦，{i}为什么{/i}还要这么拼命挣扎？

lines.en: I don’t want to leave this room.
lines.zh: 我不想离开这个房间。

lines.en: Bad things will happen if I leave this room.
lines.zh: 离开这个房间就会有坏事发生。

lines.en: I’ve heard it all along. Those whispers of the world that once seemed so illogical to me are now {i}everything{/i} and I can {i}feel{/i} them like maggots in my ears.
lines.zh: 我一直都听见了。那些从前在我看来毫无逻辑的世界低语，如今就是{i}一切{/i}，而我{i}能感觉到{/i}它们，像耳朵里的蛆虫。

lines.en: I don’t want to leave this room.
lines.zh: 我不想离开这个房间。
我不该打开那扇门。

lines.en: I know what awaits me if I do.
lines.zh: 我知道打开后会有什么在等着我。

lines.en: And I know I won’t be able to stop it.
lines.zh: 我也知道，我阻止不了。
现在怎么办？
离开房间
永远留在这里

lines.en: I will die within these walls.
lines.zh: 我会死在这四壁之内。

lines.en: But when I’m born again, I swear-
lines.zh: 但当我重生之时，我发誓——
我会做得不一样。

lines.en: I will be a better man.
lines.zh: 我会成为一个更好的人。
再见。
